findings.body: If the initial worker answer succeeds, asks a question and leaves uncommitted changes, a failing commit nudge prevents `_question` from running. Claude's normal and design paths leave `outcome` as `failed` when the nudge raises; Codex explicitly changes it to `failed`. The initial question is therefore neither persisted nor assigned an occurrence id. Subsequent work can proceed unanswered, and close.py:63–65 only blocks questions that were persisted. This adds a failure-path case beyond the previous successful-nudge finding; the new nudge tests exercise only successful nudges. Preserve questions from successful answers independently of the nudge's outcome.
findings.title: Preserve pending questions when a commit nudge fails
